title: model profile
description: profiles/<served model alias>.yaml: per-request settings for one model family. `agent` is used for tool-using worker turns, `oneshot` for tasks with no tools. Every key is sent in the request body as written; `extra` is merged in last, for server-specific keys this schema does not name.

status.description: untested until a benchmark run used it.

sources.description: Where each value came from (model card, vendor README).

narrated_markers.description: Strings that mark a tool call written into the reply's content instead of tool_calls: the model's own call delimiters. Matched as plain substrings; never sent to the server. Profiles write them with YAML escapes, so no file a worker reads holds the bare delimiters.
